rv.q: That Math Show is a unique, enlightening and entertaining evening which could even be longer!
That Math Show succeeds because Benjamin makes mathematics feel less like a subject to be mastered than an adventure to be shared.
Dr. Benjamin has an extremely engaging personality.

cn.t: Dr. Arthur Benjamin's solo show transforms mathematics into engaging entertainment, with critics praising the charismatic performer's ability to reveal the playfulness and beauty of numbers through his "math-e-magician" approach.
